title: Tensormesh, whose inference platform uses KV caching to reduce costs, raised a $20M seed extension, bringing its total funding to $24.5M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Tensormesh, whose inference platform uses KV caching to reduce costs, raised a $20M seed extension, bringing its total funding to $24.5M — Inference optimization startup Tensormesh raised a $20 million seed extension, co-founder and CEO Junchen Jiang tells Axios Pro.
